view.governing_question: What is the most complete account of this black-box component, given that the same input 'a' is recorded answering both '0' and '1'?
view.closure_assumption: The finite observation list is treated as the complete account of the component; this closure is WITHDRAWN, because it presents the same input history with two different replies.
view.polar_view: Read the reply not as a lookup over seen words but as the output of a state-carrying process whose reply to the next symbol depends on the history so far; from a fixed start, a fixed input history drives a unique reply.
view.named_obstruction: A deterministic state-carrying process sends a fixed input history to one reply; a record demanding two different replies for the identical history admits no such process at any size.

generative_commitment.generator_class_ref: a state-carrying process over the input symbols whose reply to the next symbol depends on the history so far (the declared bounded class)
generative_commitment.prediction_operator: run the recovered candidate process forward from its initial state over an input word, emitting one reply symbol per input symbol
